body:
For roughness models that don't depend on the friction velocity (constant and Raupach canopy roughness), the solver used to recompute the roughness lengths in every iteration. It now computes them once at the start of each solve and reuses them. Results are bitwise unchanged; a canopy solve is about 20% faster.

Also fixes a crash when the two wind components have different number types, e.g., when differentiating with respect to one of them with ForwardDiff.

Both changes have new tests.
title: Compute canopy and constant roughness lengths once per solve
